newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia budget boosted by welfare savings.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia budget boosted by welfare savings.

text.p: The Australian Social Security Department is running ahead of budget in recovering or avoiding overpayments, adding to the overall budget bottom line, a spokesman for Social Security Minister Jocelyn Newman said on Wednesday.
For the fiscal year to June 1997 the department had budgeted for a similar level of overpayment avoidance and recovery as in 1995/96, but had greatly improved on that performance, he said.

Newman presented parliament with figures showing the department at least A$77 million ahead of last year in the first quarter of this fiscal year -- implying a A$300 million unbudgeted gain for the full fiscal year.
The savings stemmed from more rigorous examination of social security claims, including the use of data matching from other departments, Newman told parliament.

"The Department of Social Security conducted a total of 686,423 compliance reviews in the first quarter of 1996/97, an increase of 27.6 percent of the first quarter of 1995/96 and producing a 29.3 percent increase in payment cancellation or rate reduction," she said.
